name: David Patrick Finn
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in San Diego, California
side_practice_areas: Personal Injury, Elder Law, Civil Rights
about: A premier attorney with nearly two decades of experience, David Patrick Finn strives to shoulder all of his clients’ burdens so that they can take care of themselves and their loved ones during the duration of their cases. At the law office of Finn Trial Attorneys APC in San Diego, California, he is well-equipped to handle myriad personal injury matters, ranging from catastrophic injuries, motor vehicle accidents, construction accidents and products liability to rideshare accidents, truck collisions, elder abuse and wrongful death, as well as civil cases pertaining to police misconduct and civil rights.

Mr. Finn completed his undergraduate studies in 2004, graduating with his Bachelor of Arts degree in philosophy from the University of California, San Diego. He went on to attend the California Western School of Law and received his Juris Doctor in 2006. The very next year, he obtained his license to practice across all California state courts. With a fervent passion for pursuing justice for those who need it most, Mr. Finn served at the United States Department of Justice in the capacity of an assistant United States attorney, working mostly in criminal law.

With over a decade of experience serving the government, Mr. Finn gained invaluable experience that helps his clients in their cases, understanding what steps need to be taken to ensure they are given the confidence that their legal issues will be handled with grace and care. For his many contributions, he has been peer-review rated AV Preeminent* through Martindale-Hubbell, the organization’s highest rating, and holds a perfect score of “10.0” on Avvo, along with numerous positive client testimonials on the latter site as well.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
